nuwara_eliya.description: Nuwara Eliya bungalows offer a cozy retreat in the cool climate. Perfect for relaxing and visiting tea estates.

polonnaruwa.description: Polonnaruwa bungalows are situated near ancient ruins and provide air-conditioned comfort after a long day of historical sightseeing.

kataragama.description: Kataragama bungalows are ideal for pilgrims and wildlife enthusiasts visiting the sacred city or Yala.
